selected_evidence.requirement: Publish the staged boot tree as a persistent read-only TFTP root.
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the enabled UDP/69 listener, chrooted boot root, enforcing SELinux-compatible labels, read-only file permissions, and persistent post-restart service state.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 downloads boot.cfg and firmware.bin with firmware bytes preserved.
selected_evidence.summary: Original and downloaded MD5/SHA-256 hashes match exactly before and after restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: Reject uploads and requests outside the boot root.
selected_evidence.summary: Upload attempts return rejection errors, traversal returns File not found, no probe file is created, and approved-file hashes remain unchanged.

selected_evidence.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel using legacy-compatible software.
selected_evidence.summary: Signed native CentOS 5 packages were installed; post-restart checks remain CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart persistence and recovery.
selected_evidence.summary: Captures healthy baseline boot ID d5a54c23…, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 18e80fa2…, recovered service/data, and successful remote transfers.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node2 restart persistence and recovery.
selected_evidence.summary: Captures healthy baseline boot ID 84cc174d…, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID eccd235f…, restored firewall helper, and successful post-restart downloads.
